description: Source code for a PyTorch-based object detection model implementing DETR with segmentation capabilities, including classes for backbone wrapping and main model logic.

classes.name: MaskedBackbone
classes.description: Wrapper around Detectron2 backbone to provide padding masks for feature maps.

classes.name: Detr
classes.description: Main DETR model class implementing object detection and segmentation, with training and inference methods.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs a forward pass, returning loss during training or detection results during inference.

methods.name: prepare_targets
methods.description: Prepares ground truth targets for training, normalizing boxes and masks.

methods.name: inference
methods.description: Generates detection results from model outputs, including bounding boxes, class labels, scores, and masks.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Normalizes and batches input images for the model.

methods.name: mask_out_padding
methods.description: Creates padding masks for feature maps based on image sizes.
